profile.description: Active Sept. 17-20, 2026 logging-heritage celebration alongside the Clearwater County Fair, with carnival rides, parade, vendors, entertainment and family activities. Adventure Zone's current published email route failed at the recipient server.

contacts.name: Orofino Celebrations / Lumberjack Days

notes.subject: 2026 outreach failed delivery - verify current contact
notes.body: Adventure Zone emailed info@orofinolumberjackdays.org Aug. 17, 2026. Gmail produced two delayed-delivery notices and a final failure Aug. 20 because the recipient server timed out; this is not a decline. Current regional tourism and University of Idaho sources confirm Lumberjack Days is active Sept. 17-20, 2026 with carnival rides and family activities. The event is worth a quick contact verification, although the existing carnival means Adventure Zone must determine whether there is room for a separate attraction area rather than assuming a fit.

followUps.label: Verify Orofino Lumberjack Days contact by phone
followUps.reason: The 2026 email never delivered and the event is still upcoming. Confirm a working event contact and whether there is any separate family-entertainment opportunity beyond the carnival before sending anything else.
